 ('5.3.3.2.5', 'PASS', 'maxsequence=3 in pwquality.conf.d/60-johnny-cis.conf; ' + pw + '; ' + B),
 ('5.3.3.2.6', 'PASS (manual)', 'no dictcheck=0 written (module default 1); pam_pwquality in stack; STACK-OK, OK-batch-9; ' + B),
 ('5.3.3.2.7', 'PASS (manual)', 'no enforcing=0 written (module default 1); pam_pwquality requisite in stack; STACK-OK, OK-batch-9; ' + B),
 ('5.3.3.2.8', 'PASS', 'enforce_for_root in pwquality.conf.d/60-johnny-cis.conf; ' + pw + '; ' + B),
 ('5.3.3.3.1', 'PASS', 'SET /etc/security/pwhistory.conf remember (24, site policy); STACK-OK, OK-batch-9; ' + B),
 ('5.3.3.3.2', 'PASS', 'SET /etc/security/pwhistory.conf enforce_for_root; STACK-OK, OK-batch-9; ' + B),
 ('5.3.3.3.3', 'PASS', 'pwhistory profile line carries use_authtok; ' + stk + B),

 ('5.3.3.4.4', 'PASS', 'pam_unix password line has use_authtok via unix profile; ' + stk + B),
 ('5.4.1.1', 'PASS', 'SET-PASS_MAX_DAYS 365 in login.defs; chage -M 365 aj; CHAGE-LAST-UNCHANGED; OK-batch-9; ' + B),
 ('5.4.1.5', 'PASS', 'useradd -D -f 45 and chage -I 45 aj; OK-batch-9; ' + B),

]

            l = b.getvalue()
    out.append(l)

print(n)
